description: On r-def-cat-txn-rel-accdb: process A opens it with DAO shared read/write; process C opens the lock file with all sharing and reads 256 bytes at offset 0 (one holder); process B opens it shared read/write too and C reads again (two holders); B closes and C reads again (one holder). The bytes and the file states are recorded; nothing is interpreted.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
